geo.title: Get started

Measure cans with string.

Goal: I can explain why C/d is the same for every circle (all circles are similar, 8.4) and use C = 2(pi)r and C = (pi)d.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
All circles are similar (8.4), so the ratio of circumference to diameter is the same for every circle. That constant ratio is π.

C = πd = 2πr.

A can of diameter 7.5 cm has circumference π(7.5), about 23.6 cm. Measuring cans with string and dividing C by d gives numbers close to 3.14, which is evidence; the similarity argument is the proof that the ratio is constant.
